name: Poly Haven
summary: Public library of CC0 HDRIs, photoscanned PBR textures and 3D models for rendering, VFX and games.
description: A community-funded 3D asset library. It offers HDRIs (16k+ resolution, unclipped for realistic lighting), photoscanned seamless PBR textures (at least 8k) and 3D models for visual effects and games, grouped into collections and free of paywalls or signup. Every asset is CC0; downloads work from the site, the public API and a Blender add-on.
contains: photoscanned seamless PBR textures, at least 8k
3D models for VFX and next-gen games
all assets CC0 — no paywall or signup
collections and asset packs, e.g. Lunar Landscape with scene file and Unreal project
community-funded via Patreon with public finance reports
